50.description: Tawny owl calls continuing through dark evenings
50.childFriendlyNote: Listen at dusk. One owl calls "twit" and another answers "twoo"! They're actually two different owls talking

50.description: Holly berries bright red against glossy dark green spiky leaves
50.childFriendlyNote: Shiny red berries on prickly dark leaves. Birds eat them but they're not for people. Very Christmassy!

50.description: Ivy berries forming in dark clusters, important winter food for birds
50.childFriendlyNote: Dark berries on the ivy. They're like a winter bird cafe

50.description: Robins singing boldly from fences and garden perches, defending winter territories
50.childFriendlyNote: A cheerful red-breasted bird sings even in the coldest weather. Robins are winter warriors!

50.description: Green mistletoe clumps visible in bare treetops, white berries present
50.childFriendlyNote: Green bushy balls high up in bare trees with sticky white berries. People kiss under it at Christmas!

51.description: Fieldfares present through winter, moving between fields and hedgerows
51.childFriendlyNote: Chattering flocks of speckled birds arrive from far-away Scandinavia. They love berries!

51.description: Shortest days of the year. Notice how early it gets dark and how low the sun stays
51.childFriendlyNote: The shortest day! The sun barely gets up before going back to bed, but from now on, days get longer again
